title: About
text:
Hi! I am Harry. I am a researcher working on Metal Additive Manufacturing, paticularly using in situ synchrotron techniques to understand the fundamental driving physics behind soldification processes.
I am based at the Research Complex at Harwell and have conducted synchrotron experiments at Diamond Light Source in the UK, the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility in France, and at the High Energy Photon Source in China.
This website contains information about my experience, projects I am/was involved in, and publications I have co-authored. I enjoy discussing my research and science generally, so if you are a student looking to get involved in research, a researcher looking to collaborate or understand work I have done, or an industrial engineer looking to apply my research, please feel free to reach out to me via email.

title: Experience
text:
PhD Mechanical Engineering
2022 — present · University College London
Investigating ultrasound-assisted additive manufacturing (AM) utilising in situ synchrotron radiography at ESRF and Diamond Light Source. Supervised by Peter Lee, Alex Leung, and Andrew Kao and co-sponsored by Rolls-Royce plc. and the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC).

In situ synchrotron X-ray imaging of AM processes
Development of an in situ process replicator to enable novel experiments
Collaboration with international partners on research. A particular highlight was coordinating a session of the AM block allocation group at ESRF

Placements



2023-2025 · Postgraduate Teaching Assistant · University College London, Mechanical ENgineering Department

Teaching assistant for two master’s level modules: Materials and fatigue, and Advanced Characterisation & Laboratory Techniques.

2024/5: runner-up for Mechanical Engineering PGTA awards - Best feedback
2023/4: nominated for Mechanical Engineering PGTA awards - Best student Engagement






Summer 2025 · Policy Advisor - Net Zero Innovation · Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, UK Government

Policy advisor focusing on the UK’s scaleup problems for net zero technologies, particularly in the context of the Net Zero Innovation Portfolio (NZIP).

Providing case studies on NZIP alumni and their scaleup challenges to inform novel scaleup support policies
Contributed to assessment on technological development in the UK across different sectors
